summary.headline: Parts of Faith and Fortune
summary.text: Astrological judgments about the ninth house, the Moon, Mercury, and stellar influences on religious faith, learning, divination, and reputation. The part of faith is interpreted with Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, the Sun, Venus, Mercury, and the Moon, followed by conditions involving the part of fortune, exaltations, and triplicity lords.
